name: When should I consider professional help for hardware and functional adjustments?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider professional help for hardware and functional adjustments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider professional help when you encounter hardware issues that you cannot resolve yourself, or if you lack the proper tools or expertise. This includes complex adjustments to specialized hardware, issues affecting safety like loose handrails, or when you notice problems that seem to indicate a larger underlying structural issue. Professionals can diagnose and fix problems efficiently and safely.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seek professional help for complex issues, safety concerns, or if you lack the tools or expertise.
